name: Tetrahedral Mesh Reconstruction for Emission Tomography
definition: A method for image reconstruction on tetrahedral meshes optimized for emission computed tomography with parallel beam geometry, where image intensities are defined at mesh nodes and linearly interpolated inside each tetrahedron.
summary: Tetrahedral Mesh Reconstruction for Emission Tomography is an adaptive method that optimizes image reconstruction by deforming a mesh to match intensity gradients, reducing noise in uniform regions while preserving boundary details.
